summary: RG-5 Plugin: activate ProjectContext anchoring during Recipe creation by adding briefing, nextActions tool-chaining, and grounding prompts/checks without changing four-tool business semantics.

targetTasks.summary: Current window: AlembicPlugin. Claim only task rg5-plugin-project-context-anchored-creation-t1 under stateRoot .wakeflow-active/current/alembic-recipe-evolution-optimization-2026-06-21. Context: RG-1/RG-2/RG-3/RG-4 are accepted. RG-4 is accepted after rework at AlembicPlugin commit 10b3df4d35129dba61d3c483c3e4a7081bb7eaa1, so confirmed Plan gates and testMode/moduleMining paths already exist. Goal: implement RG-5 creation-time ProjectContext anchoring as real connected Plugin behavior, not docs-only guidance. Required behavior: (1) inspect current creation surfaces and code paths first, especially Mission Briefing/OnboardingContract/DOMAIN_PLAYBOOKS/RecipeGuidanceFloor/submitKnowledgeContract and the active MCP outputs that lead a host agent to create or submit Recipe knowledge after bootstrap/rescan/moduleMining/testMode. (2) Activate the existing static SOP: creation-facing outputs must clearly anchor the host in ProjectContext MCP evidence before Recipe creation, including structured briefing/guidance that says which ProjectContext tools to use (recipe_map, alembic_graph, alembic_search, alembic_prime as appropriate) and why. (3) Add nextActions/tool-chaining hints to relevant generation/plan/briefing outputs so a host can follow ProjectContext -> evidence -> Recipe creation without guessing. These hints must be structured, bounded, and compatible with existing clean-output/public output conventions. (4) Add submit/grounding prompt or validation support for relationship-heavy Recipe claims, reusing existing RecipeGuidanceFloor/submitKnowledgeContract patterns where possible. If a hard validation gate would change public semantics too broadly, implement an additive warning/needs-evidence signal and document the boundary; do not silently accept ungrounded relationship claims as fully grounded. (5) Keep confirmed Plan authority intact and consume Plan/module/testMode context where useful; do not create a new Plugin-only Plan store or generation-state write path. (6) Preserve existing four public MCP tool business semantics except intended ProjectContext anchoring guidance; avoid breaking current clean-output contracts. (7) Add tests proving creation outputs include ProjectContext anchored nextActions/briefing, submit/grounding guidance appears for relationship claims, existing four-tool outputs remain clean/compatible, and RG-4 Plan gates still pass. Boundaries: do not implement RG-6 vector isAvailable isolation, RG-7 create/evolve immediate source_refs/vector timing repair, RG-8 commit-driven evolution/rename/new-module routing, RG-9 migration cleanup, RG-10 BiliDili real scenario, daemon/watch behavior, or deletion of evidence/proposal/vector structures. Do not add a thin doc-only layer, static mock, or visible guidance disconnected from actual MCP outputs. If the slice is too large, return blocked/needs-review with the smallest coherent split and raw evidence. Expected validation: npm run build:check; targeted RG-5 tests for ProjectContext anchored nextActions/briefing/grounding guidance; existing RG-4 PlanDrivenGenerationGate and alembic_plan tests touched by output changes; MCP clean-output/public output contract tests; HostMcpServer/CodexSession scenario tests if user-facing flow changes; lint, repo/core/layer boundary lints, git diff --check, and Alembic Guard. Return TargetResultEnvelope with commit hash, changed files, exact validation output, risks, and next-step notes.
